balance.title: Your balance
balance.body: This is your live balance. Income adds to it, expenses subtract from it. You can also correct it by hand with the pencil.

actions.title: Record money moving
actions.body: Add income or an expense here. Every entry updates the balance and shows up in your statistics.

essentials.title: Your monthly bills
essentials.body: Tick a bill once you have paid it. Only unticked bills count as money you still owe, and every figure named “after essentials” is based on them.

nextMonth.title: Planning ahead
nextMonth.body: Enter what you expect to earn next month, subtract the bills you already know about, and set the share you want to save.

statistics.title: See the whole picture
statistics.body: Statistics breaks any month down by category, by day and against previous months.

streak.title: Your streak
streak.body: The flame counts the days in a row you have opened the app. It changes colour at ten, fifty and a hundred days.

monobank.title: Monobank
monobank.subtitle: Balance and card spending read straight from the bank.
monobank.settingsDescription: Your connections. The bank token and the assistant model follow your account to every device you sign in on, while the assistant key stays in this browser.
monobank.storedLocally: The token is saved to your account encrypted, so every device you sign in on stays connected. The bank is read straight from your browser and stays a read-only view: none of your balances, transactions or statistics change because of it.

monobank.rateLimited: Monobank allows one request per minute. Try again shortly.

monobank.notConnectedHint: Add your personal token in the settings and this tab will show the card balance, the jars and every card operation.
monobank.readOnly: A read-only view of the bank. The figures below never change your balance, your transactions or your statistics.
monobank.historyStarting: Loading the history month by month, the bank gives out one month a minute.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.subtitle: Knows this account
assistant.getKey: Get a key from the provider
assistant.storedLocally: The provider and the model are saved to your account, so every device uses them. The key and the conversation stay in this browser only: questions go straight from your browser to the provider you picked, together with a summary of this account, and the Finance server never sees them.
assistant.invalidKey: The provider did not accept this key. Copy it again from its console.
assistant.syncFailed: Could not save the choice to your account. Try again.
assistant.emptyHint: The assistant sees your balance, this month's income and spending, bills, expected income, savings and your recent transactions. It can read them and do the math, but it cannot change anything.
assistant.disclaimer: Answers are based on this account and can be wrong. Not financial advice.

assistant.modelHint: The list comes from your provider once the key is connected. Search it, or type any model id and pick it by hand.
assistant.modelLocked: Connect a key to load the models

assistant.browserHint: Requests go from this browser straight to the provider, so the provider has to allow browser calls. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and OpenRouter do.
